developed_on: Synthetic_Scenes/Office/dynamic/Capture_2 (adjustment split; one full inference run, 1388 frames)
decisions: Class vote (1.0 s) replaces reset-on-class-change; resets only on gaps and jumps.
Mask-coverage-change rule (ratio 2.0 within 0.25 s) kept at its declared values; not tuned.
uncertainty_k: k = 2 did not lower the static-verified false-motion rate on Capture_2 (0% at k = 0 and k = 2), so by the declared rule k stays 0.
Ground-plane check: robust frame-fraction rule (>= 90% of frames within 2 cm) after desk tops segmented as floor failed the v1 all-frames rule on Capture_2.
use: estimate_motion.py --final-evaluation refuses any motion config whose sha256 differs from this one.
